_about: Test field. Shape and size are made up (about 3 ha, a typical small maize land); the location is real farmland near Schweizer-Reneke, North West, South Africa, where JBJ is based.
name: Test field, Schweizer-Reneke
origin_note: Local ENU origin (x = east, y = north). Schweizer-Reneke is at about 27.19 S, 25.33 E, ~1,280 m above sea level
swath_angle_note: null = parallel to the longest field edge (fewest turns)
turn_radius_note: Headland turn radius used by the planner (bigger than the tractor's minimum, so turns aren't at full lock)
